enemies.name: Slag-Mite
enemies.notes: Low scavenger darting between CRT shrines. The teaching enemy for the shave: ASTRAL hits ring the bell. Break: spills an amber shard; if Cassia-09 looms it, it cures 1 Grief stack.

enemies.name: Cassia-Pattern Patrol Unit
enemies.notes: A ferrous porcelain spider on Cassia-09's chassis pattern (also spawns as an Atrium training echo). Gramophone Resonance: a 2.5 m sonic cone + VHS Fog. Mercury Pulse: Mercury SLOW only on anyone standing in an amber shard radius. Break: freezes mid-skitter, gramophone horn leaks static. Drops an amber shard.

enemies.name: Bike Bros (Daltonized)
enemies.notes: Johnny's corrupted kin on the Spine-Highway. Fast sine drift (drift_fast: constantly repositioning, evades line-ups); nearly impossible to line up until Break-locked, which pins them mid-skid for a LINE_PIERCE (Solar Railgun). Drops the Ferro-Capacitor.

enemies.name: Porcelain Choir
enemies.notes: Arris Dome hymn (Marle's lullaby played backwards). Applies Grief-Resonance. Break-immune unless a FERRO character (Cassia-09) is in the active party. Mercy: play the opposite-phase record and they sleep (+30 Light through the Arris_Dome=Sleeping flag; R-66Y loses 4 max plates in the finale). Ruthless: overload them with [FIRE][FERRO] and they shatter screaming (+25 Dark, Arris_Dome=Incinerated, Syringe Heart Key drops early).

enemies.name: Porcelain Knight Squire
enemies.notes: Shield wall that protects Mercury Leakers (positions itself between the Leakers and the party and acts as a blocker for lines). Full crack mask; galaxy shows below 30% HP. Break: freezes kneeling.

enemies.name: Mercury Leaker
enemies.notes: Leaks a 3 m mercury pool: Mercury SLOW + Oil-Blight to anyone standing in it (the oil_pool effect should leave a persistent 3 m pool that re-applies both to standers). Orb belly sloshes.

enemies.name: Foundry Drone — Press Golem
enemies.notes: Heavy drift: its gauge fills at 0.85x (spd_mult) and allies who act adjacent to it build no BP that action. Magnetic crushers; conveyor paths reverse under Cassia's polarity swap. Break: leaves a mercury pool that recharges Mercury Pulse when Cassia stands in it.

enemies.name: Loom-Bracer Rook
enemies.notes: Elite. Tungsten wire whip, 4 m. Loom Pull drags a party member into the Break-locked body of another enemy: the pulled ally takes impact damage and is placed for a flank (needs a reposition effect; only usable while another enemy is Break-locked).

enemies.name: Marrow-Umbilical
enemies.notes: Boss add (R-66Y Phase 1 has four). Heals its boss 2 plates every 8 s while attached: a battle-time timer, not a turn action. Severing it with RUIN stops the heal but costs the severing character 15% max-HP ceiling for the rest of the battle (Krona's corrosion back-flows).
